accuracy.why: No money or licence at stake, but BLS re-issues every year and publishes formal evaluations of every past set (2014-24 occupational evaluation: 'BLS correctly projected whether an occupational group would grow or decline 86 percent of the time', https://www.bls.gov/emp/evaluations/2014-2024-occupational.htm) and the method is built for a 10-year horizon. ai_passage.text: In a future state where technology advances much more rapidly than it has historically, it is unlikely that historical relationships would hold, and therefore BLS projection methods are unlikely to yield reasonable results.

ai_evidence.search_note: AI appears throughout the release, Table 1.12 factor text and the AI exposure categories page.
